name: Interesting Mining Fix - Client
description: Optional client companion to InterestingMeFix. Lets right-click on bugged (BE-less) muck piles be forwarded to the server so the server-side auto-heal can attach the missing block entity. Without this mod, right-clicks on bugged piles are silently dropped by the client; pickaxe breaks still heal them, but right-click only starts working after the first heal.
